title: Classes of Civil Courts
display_name: Section 8, West Pakistan Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962
text: There shall be the following classes of Civil Courts: (a) The Court of the District Judge; (b) The Court of the Additional District Judge; and (c) The Court of the Civil Judge (Class I, Class II, and Class III).
source_file: Pakistan Code (pakistancode.gov.pk), West Pakistan Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962
text_normalized: There shall be the following classes of Civil Courts: (a) The Court of the District Judge; (b) The Court of the Additional District Judge; and (c) The Court of the Civil Judge (Class I, Class II, and Class III).

title: Appeals from Civil Judges to District Court or High Court
display_name: Section 18, West Pakistan Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962
text: Save as otherwise provided by any enactment, an appeal from a decree or order of a Civil Judge shall lie: (a) to the District Judge where the value of the original suit did not exceed fifty million rupees; and (b) to the High Court in any other case.
